title: Official PDK production target-selection review
scope: Read-only inspection of the current training target selector and 2025/26 official PDK overlay.

code_path.finding: Attaches official PDK labels before feature generation.
training_target=auto selects target_pdk_official when at least 1,000 finite official labels exist; otherwise it falls back to target_pdk.
target_pdk_official is carried as an outcome column, not included in the model feature whitelist; rolling PDK features are still computed from the PDK proxy column.
The isolated historical experiment instead rebuilds PDK lags chronologically from prior official target_pdk rows.

interpretation: The current default is auto, not proxy-only. With 18,412 finite official labels in the verified NBA-matched overlay, the production training selector is eligible to choose official labels by default when those labels are attached.

The wider raw official Dunkest feed contains 21,889 gameValidForDunkest=True rows. The strict matched source contains 18,412 valid rows; 3,477 valid official-source rows did not enter the verified NBA player/date/opponent match and are excluded from the experimental training set rather than force-matched.

In the local 2025/26 overlay, 18,412 rows are marked gameValidForDunkest=True and all 18,412 have finite PDK_OFFICIAL_VALID; the 5,369 false rows and 643 unmatched rows have no finite official target.

The official label is not included in FEATURE_COLS, so it is not itself a predictor. However, the production builder still creates historical PDK rolling features from the proxy PDK column; this differs from the isolated V3 experiment, which rebuilds lags from prior official PDK targets.

Prior project direction was to keep the proxy as the default and leave production behavior unchanged while official schedule/target semantics are still being verified. I did not change config/default.yaml or production code; this remains a configuration decision to resolve before enabling official targets in production.
safety: Read-only audit; no code, source parquet, official labels, model artefacts, temporal splits, or backtests were changed.
